responsibility: Implements the FR30 target’s C++ backend logic behind GCC target hooks and md helper calls. This file owns calling-convention support, frame-layout computation, prologue and epilogue expansion, argument passing and return-value decisions, frame-pointer elimination policy, trampoline emission/initialization for nested functions, operand formatting helpers, and RTL construction routines such as doubleword move expansion and multi-register checks, producing target-specific RTL and assembly-facing behavior used by the FR30 machine description.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable C++ implementation behind the FR30 port’s interface files: it defines target-hook helpers and backend routines such as frame computation, argument handling, trampoline setup, operand printing support, and multiword move expansion that are referenced by the machine description and configured by macros/options, rather than declaring configuration constants, instruction patterns, or option records.
